_doc: grill-t37 D-001.2 / T-7: expected-red registry. A red inventory row is a LEGAL expected red iff a row here names its join key AND is unexpired AND carries a code inside codes_enum - all three conjuncts are mechanical (src/shared/status-inventory.js isExpectedRed). codes_enum is a CLOSED set: adding a member is a Declaration, not an edit. approved_by is a pointer to the owner-approval line (ledger record / ADR section / commit), never the registrant's own word. Entries with an expired deadline stop certifying - they are disclosed as expired, never silently deleted.
